sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Overview[edit] The entire 40 halls and pavilions are all built on cliffs which are over 30 metres (98 ft) from the ground. The distance from north to south is longer than from east to west and it becomes higher and higher from the gate in the south to north along the mountain. The temple can be divided into a northern and southern section. Northern section[edit] The northern section contains:[1] Wufo Hall - The Hall of the Five Tathagatas Guanyin Hall - Hall of the bodhisattva Guanyin Hall of Three Religions (三教殿). The Hall of Three Religions mainly enshrines Buddhist deities as well as both Taoism and Confucianism. The statues of Śakyamuni (middle), Lao-Tze (left) and Confucius (right) are enshrined in the hall. This reflects the prevailing idea of "Three Teaching Harmonious as One" (三教合流) in the Ming and Qing dynasties (1368–1911).[1] Southern section[edit] The southern part has three floors, it contains the following halls:[1] Chunyang Palace - for worshiping Lü Dongbin - one of the Eight Immortals of Taoism Sanguan Hall (Hall of the Three Officials, 三官殿) - the largest hall in the temple, in which the "Three Great Emperor-Officials" (the officials of Heaven, Earth and Water) are worshiped with Ming era clay sculptures. Leiyin Hall (Thunder Hall) - A Buddhist hall dedicated to Buddha Śakyamuni located at the top of the southern section. ^ a b c .mw-parser-output result.historical_summary: The Hanging Temple, also Hengshan Hanging Temple, Hanging Monastery or Xuankong Temple is a temple built into a cliff near Mount Heng in Hunyuan County, Datong City, Shanxi Province, China. The closest city is Datong, 64 kilometres (40 mi) to the northwest. Along with the Yungang Grottoes, the Hanging Temple is one of the main tourist attractions and historical sites in the Datong area. Built more than 1,500 years ago, this temple is notable not only for its location on a sheer precipice but also because as a Buddhist temple it also contains references to the other two of the three Chinese traditional philosophies or religions (三教): Taoism, and Confucianism. The structure is kept in place with oak crossbeams fitted into holes chiseled into the cliffs. The main supportive structure is hidden inside the bedrock. The monastery is located in the small canyon basin, and the body of the building hangs from the middle of the cliff under the prominent summit, protecting the temple from rain erosion and sunlight bake.

answer:
**古奇峰 (Guqi Peak)** is a scenic attraction located in Hsinchu City, Taiwan. It is surrounded by lush greenery and features various temples and scenic spots, making it a popular destination for tourists. Here's a detailed overview:

### Overview
- **Location**: Hsinchu City, Taiwan
- **Historical Name**: Originally known as Pingpu Peak (平埔頂).
- **Surroundings**: The area is enriched with natural beauty, including nearby landmarks such as Shibajian Mountain, Qingcao Lake, National Tsing Hua University, National Chiao Tung University, and the Hsinchu Science Park.
- **Cultural Significance**: Guqi Peak is recognized as one of the "Eight Scenic Spots of Zhuchan" (竹塹八景), particularly noted for its panoramic views.

### Attractions
- **Temples**: The site features several temples, including:
  - Pu Tian Temple (普天宮)
  - Cuilong Temple (翠碧岩寺)
  - Qingquan Temple (清泉寺)
  - And many more, with the Pu Tian Temple being the most prominent.
- **Guqi Peak Recreation Area**: This area houses various historical artifacts, art pieces, and exquisite wood carvings, making it a cultural hub.

### Visual Tags
- **Tags**: The site is associated with tags such as panoramic views, temples, parks, and mountains, indicating its scenic and cultural richness.
- **Season**: The area is beautiful year-round, with a particular charm in spring when greenery flourishes.

### Popularity
- Guqi Peak has a popularity score of 0.7, indicating it is a well-frequented spot among visitors.

### Additional Information
- **Wikipedia Link**: For more detailed information, you can visit the [Wikipedia page](https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E5%8F%A4%E5%A5%87%E5%B3%B0).

### Summary
Guqi Peak is not only a natural wonder but also a cultural landmark, making it a must-visit for anyone traveling to Hsinchu City. Whether you're interested in hiking, exploring temples, or simply enjoying the views, Guqi Peak offers a delightful experience.

sections.title: 概要
sections.content: 概要[编辑] 古奇峰風景區以神像和廟宇及古奇峰育樂園為主，包括普天宮、翠碧岩寺、清泉寺、法雨山宏修禪苑、圓光寺、法王寺、包青宮、碧雲寺、龍泉寺、萬佛禪寺、妙覺寺、古峰寺、法源寺、財神廟天王寺、古奇峰九天玄女廟、仁光寺、開天宮、通天宮及臺灣基督長老教會聖經學院等建物[1][2]，其中以新竹普天宮最具規模，山頂有一座高120台尺莊嚴肅穆的關公像，是古奇峰的地標與精神所在。 古奇峰育樂園鳥瞰圖 古奇峰育樂園中收藏古今中外珍貴的歷史文物、藝術品與鬼斧神工雕刻的極品，詩、書、畫等精美作品、新穎別緻的木雕展示館等；古奇峰育樂園曾獲中華經貿促進會頒發優等獎，也是旅遊事業管理局指定的旅遊聖地。 普天宮附近的玻璃工藝店，偶而會有傳統噴吹玻璃的技藝表演，也是一個觀光點。 臺灣默片小生鄭連捷在此建座小廟，度過餘生[3]。 ^ 《新竹市志》，〈卷三政事志上〉，第503-504頁。（新竹市：新竹市政府，民86年） ^ 林衡道. 新竹南郊諸寺觀建除沿革. 《臺灣文獻》季刊10卷4期. 1959-12: 79-82 （中文（臺灣））.  ^ 黃仁. 〈在中國影壇發展有傲人成就的新竹人 重寫鄭超人不為臺灣人知的事跡〉. 《竹塹文獻》 (台灣: 竹塹文獻雜誌社). 2009-12, (第44期) （中文（臺灣））.

sections.content: 概要[编辑] 古奇峰風景區以神像和廟宇及古奇峰育樂園為主，包括普天宮、翠碧岩寺、清泉寺、法雨山宏修禪苑、圓光寺、法王寺、包青宮、碧雲寺、龍泉寺、萬佛禪寺、妙覺寺、古峰寺、法源寺、財神廟天王寺、古奇峰九天玄女廟、仁光寺、開天宮、通天宮及臺灣基督長老教會聖經學院等建物[1][2]，其中以新竹普天宮最具規模，山頂有一座高120台尺莊嚴肅穆的關公像，是古奇峰的地標與精神所在。 古奇峰育樂園鳥瞰圖 古奇峰育樂園中收藏古今中外珍貴的歷史文物、藝術品與鬼斧神工雕刻的極品，詩、書、畫等精美作品、新穎別緻的木雕展示館等；古奇峰育樂園曾獲中華經貿促進會頒發優等獎，也是旅遊事業管理局指定的旅遊聖地。 普天宮附近的玻璃工藝店，偶而會有傳統噴吹玻璃的技藝表演，也是一個觀光點。 臺灣默片小生鄭連捷在此建座小廟，度過餘生[3]。 ^ 《新竹市志》，〈卷三政事志上〉，第503-504頁。（新竹市：新竹市政府，民86年） ^ 林衡道. 新竹南郊諸寺觀建除沿革. 《臺灣文獻》季刊10卷4期. 1959-12: 79-82 （中文（臺灣））.  ^ 黃仁. 〈在中國影壇發展有傲人成就的新竹人 重寫鄭超人不為臺灣人知的事跡〉. 《竹塹文獻》 (台灣: 竹塹文獻雜誌社). 2009-12, (第44期) （中文（臺灣））.

query: 芝山岩, also known as 芝山巖, is a small sandstone hill located in the Shilin District of Taipei. It was named after nearby Zhilian Street and is known for its scenic views, resembling the landscapes of Zhangzhou.
answer:
芝山岩 (also known as 芝山巖) is a small sandstone hill located in the Shilin District of Taipei, Taiwan. It stands approximately 51.5 meters tall and covers an area of about 10 hectares. The hill is known for its scenic views that resemble the landscapes of Zhangzhou, China. 

### Historical Background
The name "芝山岩" was derived from the nearby Zhilian Street, and it was originally referred to as "芝蘭山" (Zhilian Mountain). The area saw a significant influx of Fujian Zhangzhou immigrants in the 18th century, who settled near the hill. Over time, the name was changed to reflect the hill's resemblance to Zhangzhou's landscapes.

### Key Features
- **Category**: Tourist Attraction
- **Popularity**: 0.7 (indicating a moderate level of interest among visitors)
- **Visual Tags**: The site is recognized for its panoramic views and is categorized under mountain and cityscape tags.

For more detailed information, you can visit the [Wikipedia page](https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E8%8A%9D%E5%B1%B1%E5%B2%A9).

If you're interested in visiting or learning more about the area,芝山岩 offers a unique blend of natural beauty and cultural history, making it a noteworthy destination in Taipei.

wikipedia.extract: 芝山岩，又寫為芝山巖，為臺北市士林區石角的獨立砂岩小山丘，位於台北盆地北側邊緣，為地勢北陡南緩的單面山，標高約51.5公尺，面積約10公頃，當地人也稱此山為「圓山仔」。大量福建漳州移民在18世紀移居該山丘附近的台北八芝蘭（今士林區），而芝山岩的名稱原取自附近的芝蘭街，而被稱為「芝蘭山」，後來因其山丘之風景很像漳州的芝山，故改稱「芝山岩」。今日亦以芝山岩取代原有之地名石角來稱呼鄰近地區，並設有芝山岩次分區。

wikipedia.title: 芝山岩
wikipedia.extract: 芝山岩，又寫為芝山巖，為臺北市士林區石角的獨立砂岩小山丘，位於台北盆地北側邊緣，為地勢北陡南緩的單面山，標高約51.5公尺，面積約10公頃，當地人也稱此山為「圓山仔」。大量福建漳州移民在18世紀移居該山丘附近的台北八芝蘭（今士林區），而芝山岩的名稱原取自附近的芝蘭街，而被稱為「芝蘭山」，後來因其山丘之風景很像漳州的芝山，故改稱「芝山岩」。今日亦以芝山岩取代原有之地名石角來稱呼鄰近地區，並設有芝山岩次分區。
